title: Water Heater Leak in a Finished Basement
summary: A leaking water heater affected several basement rooms. Once the water source was controlled, our team extracted water, removed damaged materials, cleaned the affected areas, and monitored drying until the remaining materials reached drying goals.

title: Hidden Pipe Leak Behind a Kitchen Wall
summary: Water appearing through basement ceiling fixtures led to the discovery of a concealed pinhole plumbing leak behind the kitchen. We used selective demolition to expose affected areas, then completed cleaning and structural drying after the plumber repaired the leak.

title: Hardwood Drying Without Demolition
summary: An HVAC condensate overflow allowed water to migrate beneath a staircase and into engineered hardwood flooring. Our team used targeted drying and moisture monitoring, completing mitigation without removing the flooring.

title: Sewage Backup Cleanup in Bethesda
summary: A sewage backup affected a basement laundry room, including flooring, drywall, trim, and cabinetry. We removed contaminated materials, cleaned and treated exposed surfaces, and used structural drying equipment and HEPA air filtration to complete the mitigation.

title: Church Mold Remediation Before Weekend Services
summary: Mold affected upholstered pews, overflow seating, and exposed wooden framing in a church sanctuary. Our team cleaned the affected upholstery and surfaces, applied antimicrobial treatment, and used HEPA air filtration and controlled drying. The sanctuary was left clean and dry, ready for weekend services.

title: Concealed Water Damage and Mold in Kensington
summary: Water damage and microbial growth extended into areas concealed behind family room built-ins. We completed the work in phases, using containment, HEPA air filtration, selective removal, and cleaning to address both accessible and concealed affected areas.

title: Focused Mold Remediation
summary: A localized mold problem required controlled removal and cleaning. Our team installed containment, operated HEPA air filtration, removed affected materials, and cleaned and treated the remaining surfaces, with dehumidification supporting the remediation.

title: Water Damage Across Multiple Basement Rooms in Olney
summary: Water affected a basement family room, bathroom, closets, and utility area. We removed damaged materials, cleaned affected surfaces, and deployed drying equipment across the involved rooms, monitoring moisture conditions throughout the project.
